scope: Source compatibility requirements; not a host deployment record or current machine-health check.

repository_policy.agave_patch_code_and_regressions: maintain in the validator source repository; do not copy patches into Blockzilla
repository_policy.blockzilla_agave_record: public compatibility requirements, regression checks, upstream references and removal criteria

source_build_profile.note: Pinned by zillastream/geyser-plugin/Cargo.toml. A matched host/plugin load check is required before deployment.

ledger_read_profile.note: Optional source integration. See blockzilla/ledger-archive/Cargo.toml for the required checkout layout and API.

stock_review.scope: Source review and two isolated stock-interface callback tests; no validator or ABI acceptance.

patch_groups.purpose: Bind the selected Bank and parent, native blockhash expiry and actual confirmation to one source observation.
remove_when: The selected upstream release provides the same Bank-bound native expiry and confirmation data without inferred slot or time rules.
The native tuple, deferred confirmation, actual host/plugin load and stream-control tests pass with the replacement.
patch_groups.upstream_status: No equivalent native-expiry callback was verified in the reviewed Geyser 5.0.0 interface.

patch_groups.purpose: Identify the exact failed Bank when a slot has competing or replacement Banks.
remove_when: The selected supported release includes the Bank-aware Dead dispatch; a merge into master alone is insufficient.
Two Banks at one slot remain distinct and only the failed Bank and its affected descendants are invalidated.

upstream_status.selected_release_coverage: Absent from the reviewed v4.4.1 notifier.

patch_groups.purpose: Run Bank observation and persist execution metadata while RPC listeners are disabled.
remove_when: Upstream initialization supplies processed, confirmed and rooted observations in the required order with no RPC listener.
Configured full execution metadata persists without requiring an installed Geyser plugin.
Dependency, shutdown, restart and metadata checks pass on the replacement.

upstream_status.state_at_review: open; related local-leader notification work only

patch_groups.purpose: Read exact retained Bank accounts and complete finalized ledger blocks through existing Agave handles, with bounded reads and explicit incomplete-data errors.
includes: Exact-Bank account selection and cleanup guards
Ledger metadata completion records and invalidation on writes/purge
Transaction count captured before asynchronous Bank squash
Execution metadata persistence and explicit empty rewards
remove_when: An equivalent replacement preserves exact Bank/source selection, coherent batches, finalized block identity, complete metadata and read limits.
Completion-marker, partial-write, cleanup, fork, failed-transaction and before-squash count regressions pass.
Alternatively, the owner explicitly retires the native read API and all consumers migrate; ordinary commitment-selected RPC is not silently substituted.
patch_groups.upstream_status: No equivalent complete native account/ledger socket contract was verified. Public finalized getBlock can use the separate helper and is not proof that all native API consumers have migrated.

patch_groups.purpose: Copy original UDP ingress and accepted-repair observations without taking packets away from Agave.
remove_when: No active recovery policy needs original raw ingress observations, or a replacement proves the same required coverage and provenance.
If retained, verify exact packet bytes, duplicates, repair nonce data, bounded queues, explicit loss reporting and unchanged Agave packet delivery.

checks: Exact ingress packet bytes, duplicates and accepted repair nonce data are preserved.
Queues are bounded and loss is explicit.
Normal Agave packet delivery remains unchanged.

patch_groups.upstream_status: Stock Geyser does not expose the original UDP/accepted-repair callback. This hook is not required by the compact block stream.

patch_groups.purpose: Bound the read-only RocksDB file cache without changing primary or default behavior.
remove_when: The selected upstream API offers equivalent per-open read-only file-cache limits and preserves default/primary behavior.
Equivalent limit and overflow tests pass on the replacement.
patch_groups.decision: Keep while the optional read-only ledger profile requires an explicit file-cache limit.

product_acceptance.target: Token dump starts live capture and backfills an archive range through the same reader/filter path.
product_acceptance.status: planned; not established by the current archive-only dump command

test_selection_note: Paths are relative to this repository. Tests with a scope and no path must run in the matching native integration. An empty names array is not permission to skip a check.
